title: The Thing on the Fourble Board
premise: Oil drillers recover a stone finger and ancient ring, then suffer fatal accidents around their derrick.
plays_out: Porky reveals an invisible creature brought up from underground, with a girl's face and a monstrous stone body. Twenty years later it is his disguised wife; he holds his listener at gunpoint as she approaches to eat the guest.

sources.evidence_quality: primary radio script transcript; opened and ending read
sources.ending_evidence: Paint reveals the subterranean creature; final narration identifies it as wife and the captive guest as dinner.

author: Wyllis Cooper

title: Good Ghost
premise: A murdered man's ghost tries to enrich his killer so the woman they both loved can have a happy marriage.
plays_out: Gus learns the killer has kept the fortune while leaving Ada abused and starving. Forbidden to kill his murderer directly, he kills a gangster and frames Schuster for the gang's revenge, then ascends an uncanny stairway to a waiting woman resembling Ada.

sources.evidence_quality: primary radio script transcript; opened and ending read
sources.ending_evidence: Schuster is trapped with Rollo's corpse and his own knife; gang approaches; Gus ascends to black-pompadoured woman.

author: Wyllis Cooper

title: Nothing Behind the Door
premise: Three bank robbers choose a locked, fenced-off mountain observatory building to conceal their stolen money.
plays_out: Two enter its darkness and vanish, taking the loot with them. An astronomer shows the survivor cosmic patches of literal nothing through a telescope, implying the doorway shares that void; Ross glimpses eyes and clawing shapes but refuses to describe them.

sources.evidence_quality: primary radio script transcript; opened and ending read
sources.ending_evidence: Companions never return; telescope shows cosmic nothing linked to the door; survivor warns against unknown doors.

author: Wyllis Cooper
